headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-3 on the top plays · Season: 52-217

entries.headline: Pete Alonso stayed in the yard
entries.story: Pete Alonso went 1-for-3 with 2 BB against Ryan Yarbrough and the New York Yankees. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kazuma Okamoto came close
entries.story: Kazuma Okamoto went 2-for-3 with 1 BB and 3 RBI against Nick Lodolo and the Cincinnati Reds. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "Kazuma Okamoto doubles (25) on a sharp line drive to left fielder JJ Bleday. Alejandro Kirk scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Freddy Peralta and the Tampa Bay Rays. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Cam Smith did not appear
entries.story: Cam Smith was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.
